en.title: Mendelssohn: String Quartet No.2, Op.13 – II. Adagio non lento
en.overview: This is a slow movement for two violins, viola and cello. Its home key is F major. It starts there and spends much of its time in minor keys, which gives it a darker colour. Listen for the first violin's opening melody, the moments where the viola or second violin steps forward, and the big build-up around [m. 78-89]. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, so some labels may be off. The "lead" part is also a guess, and it is often shared.

listening_points.headline: The opening melody in the first violin
listening_points.text: Violin 1 leads at the start, and the others accompany it [m. 1-2]. The level is mf. The key is F major. Small swells and fades are marked in [m. 1-4]. Then the music turns suddenly loud (f) at [m. 5].

listening_points.headline: Suddenly soft, then moving through new keys
listening_points.text: At [m. 6] the music drops suddenly to pp. The key is estimated as C major. A crescendo (getting louder) is marked at [m. 10-11]. Then the key turns to G minor at [m. 11-12].

listening_points.headline: Back in F major, with a loud peak and a hush
listening_points.text: F major returns at [m. 13] and the music is soft. It reaches f at [m. 16]. Then it drops to pp at [m. 17], and the soft level continues to [m. 19].

listening_points.headline: The viola plays alone
listening_points.text: The viola plays alone here. The level is p.

listening_points.headline: A duet, then a trio, in D minor
listening_points.text: The key darkens to D minor at [m. 22]. Violin 2 probably leads a duet [m. 22-23]. A trio of three parts follows at [m. 24].

listening_points.headline: A brighter D major, with interwoven lines
listening_points.text: D major arrives at [m. 25] and brightens the mood. For several bars the parts move independently, so there is no single clear tune. The lead is shared and uncertain. F major returns at [m. 29].

listening_points.headline: Rising tension through E minor and A minor
listening_points.text: The key moves to D minor [m. 34], then E minor [m. 38], then A minor [m. 44]. A crescendo is marked in [m. 40-42]. The level reaches f at [m. 43] and stays there to the end of this part.

listening_points.headline: A new section, softer
listening_points.text: A new section begins at [m. 46] with a new time signature. The level is back to p. Violin 1 leads over the others. It briefly reaches f at [m. 50]. At [m. 51] the key moves to D minor and the level drops to pp.

listening_points.headline: Soft shifts through G major and G minor
listening_points.text: Another new section starts at [m. 53]. The key briefly brightens to G major [m. 55-58]. Then it turns to G minor at [m. 59]. Violin 2 probably leads for a short time here, but this is uncertain.

listening_points.headline: Louder: f and a move to C minor
listening_points.text: The level jumps to f at [m. 61] and a crescendo is marked. The music stays loud. The key moves to C minor at [m. 64]. The parts mostly move independently, so the lead is shared and uncertain.

listening_points.headline: A long build in D minor towards ff
listening_points.text: D minor takes over at [m. 70] and lasts until [m. 91]. The level is f and then reaches ff at [m. 78]. It dips to f at [m. 84]. It returns to ff at [m. 86].

listening_points.headline: The estimated loudest point, then a quiet solo
listening_points.text: A new section begins at [m. 89]. A computer estimate marks this as the loudest and busiest point, at ff. A diminuendo (getting softer) is marked at [m. 91]. Violin 1 plays alone in [m. 91-92]. The key brightens to F major at [m. 92], and the level is p.

listening_points.headline: A final section in F major
listening_points.text: A final section starts at [m. 93] in F major at p. Violin 1 probably leads, with the others accompanying. The level reaches f at [m. 97]. Then the music drops to pp in C major at [m. 98].

listening_points.headline: Viola steps forward, then a loud D minor jolt
listening_points.text: The music passes through G minor [m. 102], F major [m. 105] and C major [m. 107]. At [m. 110-111] the viola probably takes the lead at pp. At [m. 113] the level jumps to f in D minor.

listening_points.headline: Settling in F major and fading away
listening_points.text: F major returns at [m. 114] and stays to the end. The level eases to p at [m. 116]. The last bar [m. 125] is marked pp. The computer labels its texture tacet (silent), but chords are still detected there, so that label may be a reading error.

glossary.explanation: The home note and scale a passage is built around. Major keys sound brighter. Minor keys sound darker.
A move from one key to another.
How the parts fit together, for example one tune with accompaniment, or several independent lines.
A part or measure where the players are silent.

zh.title: 门德尔松《第二弦乐四重奏》Op.13 – 第二乐章 Adagio non lento 听赏指南
zh.overview: 这是一个以3/4拍开始、之后多次换拍号的慢乐章，主调为F大调，共125小节。乐章开头由第一小提琴领奏。请注意音乐的强弱对比，以及调性的多次转换。第89小节是电脑估计的最响处。本指南中的调性与和弦均为软件自动估计，可能有误。“谁在领奏”也只是估算，请把握大轮廓即可。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴在F大调中开场
listening_points.text: 乐章在F大调中以中强（mf）开始。第一小提琴领奏，其他乐器伴奏 [m. 1-2]。第3到4小节是主调织体（homophonic），也就是各声部一起配合，像在一起唱和弦 [m. 3-4]。

listening_points.headline: 突然变强，再转入弱声与新调
listening_points.text: 第5小节突然变强（f）。第6小节又突然变得很弱（pp），调性转到C大调。第11小节起进入G小调，色彩变暗。

listening_points.headline: 回到F大调，力度起落
listening_points.text: 第13小节回到F大调，第一小提琴继续领奏。第15小节出现渐强标记，第16小节达到强（f）。第17小节突然变得很弱（pp），并保持到第19小节。

listening_points.headline: 中提琴独奏
listening_points.text: 第20到21小节的织体标记为独奏，由中提琴领奏，力度为弱（p）。其他乐器在这两小节里退出。

listening_points.headline: 转入D小调与D大调
listening_points.text: 第22小节转入D小调，先是两件乐器的二重奏，第二小提琴大概领奏 [m. 22-23]。第25小节转为D大调，听起来更明亮。第26小节起多为各声部独立的线条。

listening_points.headline: 弱声中不断转调
listening_points.text: 第29小节回到F大调，第34小节转D小调，第38小节转E小调。这一段大部分保持弱（p），声部线条较独立，领奏者不明确。第43小节变强（f）。

listening_points.headline: 进入新的拍号段落
listening_points.text: 第44小节转入A小调。第46小节是新的段落，拍号改变，力度回到弱（p）。第51小节起转入D小调。

listening_points.headline: 第三段开始，调性游移
listening_points.text: 第53小节又一个新拍号段落开始。调性依次为D小调、G大调、G小调。这一段的领奏者很不明确，可以当作各声部共同参与。第61小节起变强（f）。

listening_points.headline: 强声中的C小调与D小调
listening_points.text: 第64小节转入C小调，保持强（f）。第70小节转入D小调，继续保持强。第一小提琴大概领奏，但把握不大。

listening_points.headline: 进入很强的力度
listening_points.text: 第78小节起变得很强（ff）。第84小节短暂回到强（f），第86小节再次回到很强。全段保持D小调。

listening_points.headline: 估计的最响处，然后安静下来
listening_points.text: 分析认为第89小节是最响、最忙的位置（很强，ff），这只是计算机估计。第91到92小节是独奏，第一小提琴领奏。第91小节有渐弱标记。第92小节转入F大调，力度变弱（p）。

listening_points.headline: 最后一段：F大调，弱声开始
listening_points.text: 第93小节进入最后一段，F大调，弱声，第一小提琴大概领奏。第97小节突然变强（f），第98小节突然变得很弱（pp），随后进入C大调。

listening_points.headline: G小调之后再回明亮色彩
listening_points.text: 第102小节转入G小调，第105小节回到F大调，第107小节转入C大调。第108小节短暂变强（f）。第110小节中提琴大概领奏，力度很弱（pp）。

listening_points.headline: 回到F大调，轻轻收束
listening_points.text: 第112小节短暂转入D小调，第113小节变强（f）。第114小节起回到F大调，并保持到结尾。第125小节是最后一小节，力度为很弱（pp）。电脑把这里的织体标为休止（tacet），但仍测到和弦，这个标记可能是识别误差。

glossary.explanation: 各声部节奏大体一致，像一起唱和弦。
只有一件乐器在演奏，其他乐器不出声。
声音逐渐变大或变小。没有这类标记时，变化是突然的。
音乐的中心调改变。大调通常更明亮，小调更暗淡。
